group_assessment.weighting: PubMed ESearch 2026-10-02: Tsuruwaka Y[au] 10 records, 1 intersecting WWOX (this paper). A zebrafish live-imaging group (yellow-cameleon FRET Ca2+ imaging is their declared method, with a self-cited 2007 methods paper). Competent at the imaging; WWOX is a single encounter, and every WWOX statement in the Discussion is drawn from cited mouse, rat and human work rather than measured here.

field_density.note: Two records intersect WWOX and zebrafish; this is the only one carrying a live calcium readout. There is no second vertebrate wwox calcium-imaging study to replicate or contradict it.

multihop.enumeration_method: All 24 references enumerated from the JATS deposit. Twelve mention WWOX, and the PeerJ deposit carries no pub-id/pmid element on any of them, so no gene-direct reference can be addressed by PMID from this artefact alone. Declared empty rather than padded with author-year strings that cannot be resolved deterministically.

corpus_crossquery.note: CORPUS P318 and LIT-0318 are the identity records; DL-MECH-021 already states both halves of the morphometric result, including that the rescue succeeds with the SDR/ADH domain alone. This reading adds that the calcium endpoint itself is unquantified and unrescued, which DL-MECH-021 does not say.

entries.proposition: The knockdown is morpholino plus siRNA with stated penetrance, not a mutant allele.
entries.snippet: with 56% and 62% penetrance of edema in 48 hpf embryos after injections with MOs and siRNA, respectively
entries.anchor: Results, Knockdown and detection of zebrafish wwox, para 1

entries.proposition: A rescue arm exists, contrary to the assignment's premise, and it uses the ADH/SDR domain only, not full-length wwox.
entries.snippet: RNA rescue experiments were performed after preparing wwox mRNA (ADH domain region) by replacing pTAC-2 with the pCS-2 vector
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods, Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and complementary DNA (cDNA) cloning

entries.proposition: The rescue is reported as succeeding for the oedema phenotype with both knockdown reagents.
entries.snippet: However, wwox mRNA rescued the phenotype in MO and siRNA injected embryos
entries.anchor: Results, Knockdown and detection of zebrafish wwox, para 1

entries.proposition: Calcium imaging is performed after the oedema has already formed, so the measurement cannot order cause and consequence.
entries.snippet: dynamics after edema formation in embryos that had been simultaneous transfected with yellow cameleon
entries.anchor: Results, Analysis of intracellular Ca2+ dynamics after edema formation, para 1 (sentence continues 'dynamics after edema formation in embryos')

entries.proposition: The authors themselves raise a non-cell-autonomous explanation for the phenotype.
entries.snippet: Therefore, inhibition of wwox could have pointed a non-cell-autonomous phenotype

entries.proposition: The calcium figure is one representative colour-coded image per condition with no quantification, no n, no statistic and no rescue arm; the morphometric figure beside it carries all three.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4 contains exactly four sub-panels (bright-field and colour-coded ratio image for wild type and for knockdown) and no axis, error bar, sample size or significance marker anywhere; Figure 2E by contrast plots body length and eye size with error bars and drawn significance brackets for WT, control, phenotype and rescue.
entries.anchor: Figure 4 (peerj-03-727-g004.jpg) compared with Figure 2E (peerj-03-727-g002.jpg), native JPEGs inspected

entries.proposition: The eye-size deficit is restored by the rescue mRNA to control level, which is the one endpoint in this paper that behaves like a rescue readout.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2E right plot, eye size in micrometres: wild type about 265, control about 255, phenotype about 205, rescue about 270, with drawn significance brackets marked ** over WT-versus-phenotype and phenotype-versus-rescue.
